fields.statement: QA at a6c27bb4 with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), REX_CONFIG pointing at a scratch folder and a fake rex on PATH for the reload: `rhiza rex install` wrote rhiza.lua with `local BIN = "rhiza"` plus the settings.bin guard and a commented `-- bin` example in the settings block; the binary's own scratch path appears nowhere in the file. A second install reported both files unchanged and cmp showed rhiza.lua byte-identical. With bin = "/home/me/go/bin/rhiza" and launch_key "ctrl+a g" set in the settings block, a reinstall left the file byte-identical (cmp). An old-style rhiza.lua with `local BIN = "/Users/darinhaener/bin/rhiza"` was rewritten on reinstall to the PATH form, keeping the owner's settings. The real Rex (`rex config check` with REX_CONFIG on the scratch init.lua) loads the generated file (24 bindings, 1 mode, 22 actions). A probe copy raising error("PROBE BIN="..BIN) after the guard, loaded by real Rex, gave BIN=rhiza for a missing bin, "", 42 and false, and BIN=/home/me/go/bin/rhiza when that string is set. go test ./internal/api -run TestRexInstall and TestScripts/rex-install pass.
